result.document_summary: A portion of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 3, Article 3 (police-regulated businesses: secondhand dealers, junk yards, solicitors, entertainment establishments), retrieved from a page nominally about the anti-competitive automated rent price-fixing division.
result.notes: This part contains only sections 33.1105-33.1502 (junk yards, pawnbrokers, solicitors/peddlers, entertainment establishments definitions). None address rent increases, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting, so no in-scope rules were extracted. The algorithmic rent-setting provision (Division 11 / section 98.1103) named in the URL does not appear in this part of the text.
